property_summary: The getBalance function must return the exact stored balance for every address; the mutant adds 1, breaking the identity property that getBalance(u) always equals the previously recorded deposit value.
change_summary: Return userBalance[u] + 1 to always differ from original storage value.
mutated_unit_code: function getBalance(address u) public view returns (uint) { return userBalance[u] + 1; }
